benches.description: TX HBT chain (pre-driver, FFE line driver) into 100 ohm, FFE off and on: swing, rise/fall, collector and reverse-Vbe stress, supply current
benches.corner_set: per request: one HBT process corner x 3 supplies x 3 temperatures; six requests give the 54-point PVT-full set
benches.limitations: R4 loads each output with a 4 ohm series stand-in, the extracted pad-metal C (70.66 fF per leg, quasi-static lumped, layout/analog/pads/records/2026-11-12-fc8a7fa) and the PDK ESD clamp diodes into the 100 ohm differential termination; no bondwire/package, no pad-to-pad coupling, PDK dantenna/dpantenna equivalence to the clamp not established (LVS #27); simulated, not measured. R4 steady-state swing is insensitive to the pad C (record 20261112-141317-582746a). R16 covers the TX supply current only; RX and clock-path current are not measured here. R5 is graded at FFE off/on; the 4-step code sweep is tx-mos-ffe-en

benches.description: Clock buffer + CML sampling latch at 5 GHz: regeneration time and node stress; the latch record that DR-002 fits are made from
benches.corner_set: 3 HBT process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Regeneration time only: sampler offset/noise Monte Carlo is not in this bench; no record carries those statistics. The statistical eye (R8, R15) is link-r8-sensitivity / link-r15-method, which print the sampler offset/noise as UNFITTED ASSUMPTIONS. Regeneration is measured to two fixed absolute levels of |q|, neither swing-relative (a .meas card cannot reference an earlier .meas result and expr is unusable on the fleet runner, klayout-tools#4217): 0.25 V (the decision level the DR-002 fits need) and a 0.10 V floor level every corner crosses. At the six 1.080 V corners peak |q| asymptotes below 0.25 V, so latch_t_regen_up/dn are graded not_reached there (on_unreached: null) rather than erroring the corner -- a swing limit, not a speed limit: the same corners reach the 0.10 V floor in 6.6-17.5 ps. No corner in the grid misses the 100 ps first-look limit at either level. The request still exits 3 because the nine 1.320 V corners exceed the DR-003 collector limit; that is a separate, recorded finding and is not relaxed here. Newest record: sim/rx/records/20261114-050716-eb34d10 (errored 0, not_reached 12)

benches.description: Clamp DC IV of the diodes and seam resistor the layout extractor found in pad_esd.gds (2 dantenna + 2 dpantenna at 35.0028 um2 / 58.08 um, rsil 5.12 ohm; record 2026-11-12-fc8a7fa), padp leg, pad swept -0.6..1.8 V against VDD = supply
benches.corner_set: 3 HBT process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Extracted-clamp characteristics only (R19 wording): DC IV, not TLP or HBM, no ESD qualification claim and no level claimed. PDK dantenna/dpantenna are reverse-bias fits and do not model forward bipolar action, so the forward currents are a lower bound; the sg13g2 diode corner sections do not move these models (identical across the three process legs). Series rsil is an ideal 5.12 ohm (extracted, nominal 7 ohm/sq in the generator, not verified). Only the padp leg; the rx_term_pad cell is unrouted and not covered; simulated, not measured

benches.description: TX driver + pad network SDD22 (100 ohm differential) from 1 MHz to 10 GHz via a 100 ohm AC port; driver on (bias live, pair balanced, FFE slices off) and a driver-off reference (vbn = 0)
benches.corner_set: per request: 3 HBT/CAP/DIO ganged process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: Pad: the PDK bondpad model has no capacitance, so each bondpad is the extracted pad-metal C (70.66 fF to ground, quasi-static lumped, layout/analog/pads/records/2026-11-12-fc8a7fa) plus the PDK ESD diodes; no bondwire/package, no pad-to-pad coupling, no distributed 5 GHz effect; PDK dantenna/dpantenna equivalence to the clamp not established (LVS #27); only the TX padp leg; simulated, not measured. DC is approximated by 1 MHz (AC-coupled port). Driver-on is the FFE-off balanced-pair small-signal point; FFE-on slices and the mux/predriver input stage are not exercised (mux outputs replaced by their DC mid level). rsil is the behavioural stand-in at typical rsh, no resistor corner. No limits are attached: the bench reports SDD22, it does not claim a pass

benches.description: Receiving clock buffer clk_buf_quad driven by an ideal 5 GHz quadrature source: duty of the 0/180 and 90/270 pairs, 90 and 270 degree quadrature delays, swing and crossing slew
benches.corner_set: 3 HBT/CAP/DIO ganged process corners x 1.08/1.2/1.32 V x -40/27/125 C (PVT-full)
benches.limitations: RANDOM JITTER IS A GAP: a noise-free ngspice transient has no RJ and .noise is small-signal about DC, so no rms jitter is measured; the crossing slew is reported as the AM-to-PM factor only (RJ = noise rms / slew needs a declared noise source, not provided). Input clock is ideal (source quality not modelled; deterministic error here is the buffer's own). Load is a 20 fF placeholder per output. Duty and quadrature are read from differential pairs A (0/180) and B (90/270); single-ended duty is not measured
